name: Izumozaki (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Izumozaki town emblem in white: a stylised angular device of a broken ring, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Izumozaki, a town in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 June 1966.

features.role: Izumozaki town emblem — a stylised angular device of a broken ring, like a stylised character
